v2-talk-pause-down._bow_why: 2026-10-27 the conductor: a BOW BAND (the 10-24/25 law): its tiles serve the frames whose pitch lies inside this take's own tiles' span (-44..-21); a frame deeper keeps her filmed mouth; a frame above it is forward and paints from the forward picks (pose-bow-map.py writes clip-*.bow.json, HOUSE_MOUTH_BOW=1 on the bench)
v2-talk-pause-down._bow: the User 10-28: retired as a band and a rank - the heads-down working take (v2-talk-pause-work) carries every down frame; bows are capped at what it reaches (MASTER-PROMPT 6d/6e)

v2-talk-pause-soft-45l.library_why: the 45 band's own name (the User 2026-10-28: 'from 12 deg of turn onward this is why we shot the 45 tiles'): the painter finds the turn take by its library == HOUSE_TURN_LIB_45; tagged v2-listen-screen it found the forward take first and turned frames painted nothing (Crissa: profile-45)
